title: First compatible term index
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a finite DNF formula on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction for which the restricted formula takes different values on some two binary assignments to the free coordinates. The first compatible term index is the least index in the formula's list whose term is compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: the restriction is bad for the formula
